{{Top|leg}}
A '''magnetic field projector''' was a device capable of generating a [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic field]].

Magnetic field projectors were installed around the edge of a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], generating a magnetic field that kept the interior of the bay protected from the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
